notes: 0.4 HQ articulation: layered facade, portal blades, spandrel bands, optional fins, close-up micro detail and configurable command variants.
COMMAND style: glazed lobby, stronger vertical accents and optional corner glazing. Exterior shell only.
HQ/UNIT families remain visual shell assets only; no complete interior room layout is generated.
BARRACKS style: repeated room bays with external stair tower and compact entry volume.
HQ/UNIT families remain visual shell assets only; no complete interior room layout is generated.
Moving panels are preview/asset transforms, not a tested runtime Unreal door Blueprint.
AS07 retained source geometry; new local foundation optional. AS07 structural collision uses static complex geometry, not whole-building boxes.
RANGE_SET is fictional CGI scenery only. Dimensions are artistic. No live-fire suitability, ballistic containment, protective material or safe-distance claim.

rules.role_rule: equal roles, or HANGAR<->APRON; PEDESTRIAN_OPENING always needs a landing adapter
rules.placement_rule: direct butt joint only: surface gap, facing and up-vector within tolerance; no path routing

PK01.title: Port metadata convention
PK01.note: pk01_width / pk01_height / pk01_role custom properties on port Empties.

grammar: one panel token per bay, per side (LEFT/RIGHT); bays 4..12
depth / bays (bay pitch) must be 2.8..6 m
two ENTRY_TYPES panels may not be adjacent
with local_ground+landings an entry bay needs pitch >= walkway_width + .12 m
default sequence: CLERESTORY everywhere, METAL first, LOUVER last, PERSONNEL in bay 2 (LEFT) / bays-1 (RIGHT)
main gate: 4/6/8 telescopic leaves; side pocket >= leaf + .25 m; opening_height + .95 <= eave_height

single-storey straight strip; no corner/closure modules exist yet
